mapper.sql: SELECT s.*, u.name AS user_name, o.name AS organization_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suggestion_comment sc WHERE sc.suggestion_id = s.id) AS comment_count FROM suggestion s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_organization o ON s.organization_id = o.id
mapper.select:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND s.status = #{request.status}
AND (s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR s.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT sc.*, u.name AS user_name, ru.name AS reply_user_name FROM suggestion_comment sc LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON sc.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN suggestion_comment rsc ON sc.reply_comment_id = rsc.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON rsc.user_id = ru.id WHERE sc.suggestion_id = #{suggestionId} ORDER BY sc.create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE suggestion SET vote_count = vote_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE suggestion SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
